description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources within a combined training set, as indicated by the title “Distribution of data source in the combined training set.” The chart contains ten slices representing different data sources. The slices are labeled as follows: SCIFACT, colored blue, representing 31.3%; FEVER, colored orange, representing 16.1%; SNLI, colored teal, representing 15.4%; MULTIFC, colored pink, representing 11.3%; VITAMINC, colored orange, representing 13.0%; ANLI, colored light blue, representing 4.6%; FACTCC, colored yellow, representing 2.6%; ENTFA, colored red, representing 1.8%; PUBHEALTH, colored green, representing 0.5%; SCITAIL, colored light pink, representing 1.2%. The chart includes a legend listing each data source and its corresponding color. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
